description: Department of Local Government - North Western Province - M. S. M. Rafeek has been elected as the Chairman of the Puttalam U/C
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the election result of a specific individual (Mr. Mohomad Saleehu Muhammadu Rafeek) to the position of Chairman of the Puttalam Urban Council. The content is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, making it directly related to electoral processes and results, which is the defining characteristic of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
